Dev Dashboard app (Client ID and secret) For an app created in Shopify's Dev Dashboard. Odoo exchanges these for an access token and renews it automatically — Shopify does not show you a token to copy on this path. Existing Admin API access token For a store that already holds a long-lived Admin API access token from an app created the older way.

Both values are on your app's Overview page in the Dev Dashboard This works only when the app and the store belong to the same Shopify organization. The token Shopify issues lasts 24 hours; Odoo requests a fresh one before it expires, so there is nothing to renew by hand. Shopify's guide: Get API access tokens (Dev Dashboard).
Secrets entered here are write-only They are protected by access control, not by encryption at rest. Anyone with database access can read them, so treat database backups as containing them.

The Admin API access token is the one that goes in the field below. If your app only shows a Client ID and Client secret, use the Dev Dashboard path above instead. This withdraws the first-push decision of every pair under this Shopify location. Each affected pair returns to Pending: no stock can be pushed for it until a new preview is run and explicitly confirmed, and the old confirmation is never reused. Administrator only, and the reason below is recorded on the audit trail against this location and against every pair it touches.

Once every pair of this Shopify location is back to Pending, the Administrator remap on its location mapping becomes possible. The remap guard itself is unchanged: this is the governed route to the state it requires, not a way around it.

Nothing has ever been pushed for this pair, so Shopify is not affected by withdrawing the decision.

host_framework_limitation.consequence: The invalid state itself is conveyed visually; the REFUSAL is conveyed to assistive technology by Odoo's notification, which is `role="alert" aria-live="assertive"` and names the field.
host_framework_limitation.ownership: Odoo chrome, not connector arch. Not fixable from this repository without patching core, and disclosed rather than asserted away.
host_framework_limitation.what: Odoo 19 marks an invalid field with the class `o_field_invalid` and emits no `aria-invalid` anywhere in web/static/src at the pinned commit 30bde9ff.
